items.title: AFK night → 2026-11-09
items.body:
## crow

The login demo and the review ledger shipped. Nothing waits on you.

- **Demo login**: magic link sign-in works end to end on the fixture server
- **Review ledger**: common patterns now feed the self-review gate
- **Ops lanes**: a stuck lane shows its last log line

## nest

Two small fixes, both tested.

- **Inbox swipe**: answer and snooze no longer fire twice
- **Agenda**: all-day events sit above the hours

items.body:
# Retro batch · 6 sessions

4 lessons applied, 1 proposed.

## Applied

- Shots: keep the chat folded unless the item is about chat
- Commits: check `git diff --cached --stat` before each commit
- Designs: compare the build against the board before showing it
- Runbook: dispatch on an allowed account only

## Proposed

- A review pattern for missing 409 refresh in confirm sheets

### Sessions

- nest-mrs-build · 2 corrections
- crow-deck · 1 redirect
